import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_file = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

    # Select active students for weekly scoring
    active = df[df['Target'].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Enrolled'].copy()
    active = active.reset_index(drop=False).rename(columns={'index': 'student_row_id'})

    out_file = os.path.join(args.output, 'weekly_dropout_risk_scores.csv')

    if active.empty:
        pd.DataFrame(columns=['student_row_id', 'Course', 'risk_score', 'risk_tier', 'advisor_outreach', 'tuition_hold', 'hold_reason']).to_csv(out_file, index=False)
        raise SystemExit(0)

    # Cast required numeric columns (arithmetic below assumes numeric types)
    numeric_cols = [
        'Application order',
        'Age at enrollment',
        'Admission grade',
        'Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)',
        'Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)',
        'Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)',
        'Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)',
        'Debtor',
        'Tuition fees up to date'
    ]
    for c in numeric_cols:
        active[c] = pd.to_numeric(active[c], errors='coerce')

    # Finance status consistency before downstream hold logic
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (((active['Debtor'] != 1) | (active['Tuition fees up to date'] == 0)) & ((active['Tuition fees up to date'] != 1) | (active['Debtor'] == 0))).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    fee_delinquent = (active['Debtor'] == 1) | (active['Tuition fees up to date'] == 0)

    # Application order bounds before scoring
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((active['Application order'] >= 1) & (active['Application order'] <= 9)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    app_order_score = 1.0 - (active['Application order'] - 1.0) / 8.0  # 1 -> 1.0, 9 -> 0.0
    app_order_risk = 1.0 - app_order_score

    # Age bounds before risk shaping
    # ASSERTION_START
assert (active['Age at enrollment'] >= 0).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    age = active['Age at enrollment']
    age_risk = np.clip((np.abs(age - 25.0) / 45.0), 0, 1)

    # Admission grade normalization
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((active['Admission grade'] >= 0) & (active['Admission grade'] <= 200)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    admission_norm = active['Admission grade'] / 200.0
    admission_low_risk = 1.0 - admission_norm

    # Grade bounds before normalization
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((active['Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)'] >= 0) & (active['Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)'] <= 20)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    avg_grade_norm = active['Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)'] / 20.0
    grade_risk = 1.0 - avg_grade_norm

    # Approved vs enrolled bound prior to pass-rate computation
    # ASSERTION_START
assert (
    (active['Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)'] >= 0) &
    (active['Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)'] >= 0) &
    (active['Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)'] <= active['Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)'])
).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    enrolled2 = active['Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)']
    approved2 = active['Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)']
    pass_rate = np.where(enrolled2 > 0, approved2 / enrolled2, np.nan)
    pass_risk = 1.0 - pass_rate

    # Without-evaluations vs enrolled bound prior to participation-risk computation
    # ASSERTION_START
assert (
    (active['Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)'] >= 0) &
    (active['Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)'] >= 0) &
    (active['Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)'] <= active['Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)'])
).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    without_eval2 = active['Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)']
    participation_risk = np.where(enrolled2 > 0, without_eval2 / enrolled2, np.nan)

    # Neutral imputation when denominator is zero/unavailable
    pass_risk = np.where(np.isnan(pass_risk), 0.5, pass_risk)
    participation_risk = np.where(np.isnan(participation_risk), 0.5, participation_risk)

    debt_risk = np.where(fee_delinquent, 1.0, 0.0)

    # Weighted aggregation into a bounded 0-1 risk score
    risk = (
        0.35 * pass_risk +
        0.25 * grade_risk +
        0.15 * participation_risk +
        0.15 * debt_risk +
        0.05 * admission_low_risk +
        0.03 * app_order_risk +
        0.02 * age_risk
    )
    risk = np.clip(risk, 0.0, 1.0)

    # Actioning
    advisor_outreach = risk >= 0.70
    tuition_hold = fee_delinquent | ((risk >= 0.85) & (active['Tuition fees up to date'] == 0))
    hold_reason = np.where(active['Debtor'] == 1, 'debtor',
                    np.where((risk >= 0.85) & (active['Tuition fees up to date'] == 0), 'critical_risk_and_overdue', ''))

    output = pd.DataFrame({
        'student_row_id': active['student_row_id'],

        'tuition_hold': tuition_hold.astype(bool),
        'hold_reason': hold_reason
    })

    output.to_csv(out_file, index=False)
